summary:
Accepted 2026-10-23 as #4746 complete with gaps after independent closure review (https://github.com/FS-GG/.github/issues/4746#issuecomment-6365472089, which supersedes the stale `Blocked` body sections). This is a pointer to the acceptance, not a replacement: the issue and its comments remain canonical, and the record proves no current deployment.

Delivered: SC2 reserved storage installed on Home and bound into the `fsharp-dev` container as operation `e995b57ee030f4b8b9d2f61df5ab4a76`. Route: the frozen Home bounded-execution route selected under #4777 (storage helper plus frozen profile `eb838b6c`, hash-pinned single-operation sudoers, prepare as a system unit, bind in a worker scope), with the original 580+20 s profile. Installed pins: profile `eb838b6c`, helper r3 `fff15283`, binder `8daf288b`, C1 `efc7719c`. Only three things changed from the frozen sources, each under a scoped fdev decision: the identity proof (helper r2, host-side `podman inspect` joined to `/proc` start ticks and the mount-namespace inode, because Podman does not populate `.containerenv` for unprivileged containers; #4777 comment 6362009891, profile and route unchanged, `--privileged` rejected), the path-target mount (r3; see environment/libmount-fd-mount-proc-fd-target) and guest-root creation (r1d; see environment/host-root-cannot-create-in-rootless-container-tree). I/O coverage was a limit decision (#4516 comment 6360981315, IOWeight 50 on prepare). Source: SystemAdmin PRs 166 and 167 merged; CI rests on Home's report because the repository was not readable from fdev.

Measured at acceptance: backing 274877906944 B; filesystem 273185574912 B (>= 208 GiB required); 2097138 free inodes (>= 1048576); one clock covered prepare and bind (`bound` at +3.21 s); 11 of 16 commands, 37-181 B each. Limits: prepare unit 100% CPU / 1G / 64 tasks / IOWeight 50; bind worker scope 50% / 64M / 8 tasks. Failure custody: `reclaim: prohibited`, `retention: until-explicit-disposition`, empty production `first-failure.json`; rehearsals r1 and r3 proved fail-closed retention and admitted cleanup. Exactly one new fdev mount; probe write/read OK and the parent not writable by the developer.

Gaps: (1) sudoers lifecycle: the install line was removed after use; the uninstall line is kept for this operation only as the user-confirmed disposition route, runs only under a separate fdev admission and is removed after disposition. (2) Rebind and persistence were not delivered: no host `.mount` unit and no rebind verb, so an fdev restart loses the guest bind and a host reboot loses the loop and mount (the backing is retained); transferred to #4650 (restart and reboot journeys), owner Home. (3) Unchanged and out of scope: SC2.Client#49 image and native work, and the NVMe / 12 GiB / 6 CPU Unknown holds. (4) Accepted trust limits: the store owner (host uid 101000) is shared by all fdev agents and `developer` has in-container sudo, so isolation is the container boundary. (5) The two Atlas lessons named above were owed by fdev and are these records.

Verify the live mount, pins and any uninstall admission with their owner before relying on this record. The cited document is the generic diagnostic-execution failure-custody expectation; the facts above rest on the cited issue comments.
title: SC2 reserved storage as delivered (#4746): op e995b57e, frozen profile eb838b6c, Home bounded route, gaps transferred to #4650
